name: SPACE sandbox platform
what_is_published: SPACE, the platform Computer's sessions execute on, published 15 October 2026.
label: sandbox

name: The agent and its planner
what_is_published: Nothing. Computer plans a goal into subtasks and hands them to sub-agents inside Perplexity's product; the planner has never been published.
label: agent

name: The model router
what_is_published: Nothing. Perplexity routes each query across models it selects; the router is outside the scope of the SPACE release.
label: router

name: The managed connector catalogue
what_is_published: Nothing. Gmail, Outlook, GitHub, Linear, Slack and Notion are reached through connections Perplexity manages and authorises; the catalogue is not published.
label: connectors

name: Portable Computer runtime
what_is_published: Nothing. Portable Computer runs the orchestrator, planner, scheduler and sandbox on the subscriber's own NVIDIA GPU, and still requires a Pro or Max plan: closed code on hardware you own.
label: portable

name: The Agent API's Profiles, Skills and managed connectors
what_is_published: A subscriber can declare versioned Profiles and Skills and reuse them across applications, but the definitions execute inside Perplexity's cloud.
label: build surface
